title: ENABLE_NFTABLES is deprecated (v1.13.2) — the iptables mode now follows kubelet's

detection.reason: read from the env NAMES of the aws-node DaemonSet's containers (the agent ships names, never values) — a variable injected through envFrom / the chart's extraEnv from a ConfigMap is not seen

quote: Set iptables mode automatically and deprecate ENABLE_NFTABLES
remediation: Remove ENABLE_NFTABLES from the aws-node DaemonSet. From v1.13.2 the CNI chooses iptables-legacy or iptables-nft by detecting the mode kubelet uses, so the variable no longer forces a backend; make sure the node OS, kube-proxy and kubelet agree on one mode, because switching modes with rules installed is not reconciled (drain nodes before changing it).
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get ds aws-node -o json | jq -r '.spec.template.spec.containers[] | .env[]? | select(.name == "ENABLE_NFTABLES") | "\(.name)=\(.value)"'  # a printed line is a setting v1.13.2+ no longer honours
coversNotes: ENABLE_NFTABLES (introduced in v1.12.1, deprecated in v1.13.2+) Type: Boolean as a String

title: Boolean env values are parsed case-insensitively from v1.13 — "True"/"TRUE"/"1" flip from off to on

detection.reason: env VALUES are not collected (names only)

quote: Make all the aws vpc cni environmental variables case insensitive
remediation: Before v1.13 the aws-node entrypoint and the aws-vpc-cni-init container compared these booleans to the exact string `true` (d944328c): ENABLE_IPv6, ENABLE_POD_ENI, ENABLE_PREFIX_DELEGATION, ENABLE_BANDWIDTH_PLUGIN, ENABLE_NFTABLES and DISABLE_TCP_EARLY_DEMUX. v1.13 parses them with strconv.ParseBool, so `True`, `TRUE`, `t` and `1` now turn the setting ON where they used to leave it off, and an unparseable value falls back to the documented default. Normalise them to lowercase true/false before upgrading.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get ds aws-node -o json | jq -r '(.spec.template.spec.containers[], .spec.template.spec.initContainers[]?) | .name as $c | .env[]? | select(.name | test("^(ENABLE_IPv6|ENABLE_POD_ENI|ENABLE_PREFIX_DELEGATION|ENABLE_BANDWIDTH_PLUGIN|ENABLE_NFTABLES|DISABLE_TCP_EARLY_DEMUX)$")) | select(.value != null) | select(.value | test("^(true|false)$") | not) | select(.value | test("^(?i:true|false|t|f|1|0)$")) | "\($c): \(.name)=\(.value)"'  # each printed variable was read as false before v1.13 (unless it is exactly "true") and is parsed as a real boolean after
